profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Ericsson | DevOps | Kubernetes | Platform Engineering | CI/CD | Distributed Systems
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer and Solution Architect with 10+ years of experience building enterprise platforms, internal tools, and cloud-native solutions. Experienced in DevOps, CI/CD, and fullstack development using Java, React, and Angular. I’ve also contributed to AI-driven initiatives by integrating generative tools into engineering workflows to enhance automation and delivery. I focus on building secure, scalable systems that align development and operations.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Solutions Architect
positions.description:
AI & Automation Lead / DevOps Engineer / Cloud Architect / Fullstack Engineer
- MANA RC LCM Factory Project – T-Mobile (USA): DevOps automation and CI/CD pipelines with GitLab, Ansible, and Vagrant.
- BNE CI/CD Pipelines Project – T-Mobile (USA): End-to-end CI/CD architecture with Kubernetes, Artifactory, and secure delivery practices.
- Internal AI & Automation Initiatives – Ericsson: AI-driven test automation tools using Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, and Robot Framework.
- 5G/IoT Innovation & Presales – Ericsson: Prototyping smart systems using cloud + NB-IoT sensors and real-time dashboards.
- SA BSS DevOps Project – Ericsson: Configuration-as-code and secure deployments for SWDP CDD on Kubernetes.
- End-to-End Software Delivery – Telstra: Automation frameworks using GitLab CI/CD and Ansible for product delivery at scale.

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description:
Solutions Architect / Integration Architect / DevOps Engineer 
The more relevant tasks:
-DevOps CI/CD creation for all Ericsson’s project applications. BSCS, OCS, EOC, ECM, EMA, EMM, Siebel, IWS, Oracle POS.
-Automation Testing framework creation for E2E Entel’s TDE Solution. 
-DevOps CI/CD creation for Ericsson Ooredoo solution in Qatar.
-Creation of Ericsson DevOps Framework (EDF) for Ericsson OSS/BSS products.
-Development and support of the Commercial Validation Layer project. (Chile, Perú)
-Development and support of the OSB integration services, TDE. (Chile, Perú)
-Generic java soap client for alternative web services solutions.
-Entel Chile and Entel Peru TDE production environment tuning and stabilization. 
-Analysis and solution of defects in IST, UAT, PP and PROD environment. (Chile, Perú)

positions.title: Senior SOA Consultant
positions.description:
-Design the architecture and logging system with JMS queues for the Commercial Validation Layer project.
-Developer of the Commercial Validation Layer project.
-POC and development of Oracle Coherence, Event Polling, Business Rule and Decision Tree projects.
-Development of OSB.
-Analysis and solution of defects in IST, UAT, PP and PROD environment.

projects.title: Transformación Digital Entel CVL
projects.description: Desarrollo de servicios de alto rendimiento y alta concurrencia para capa de validación comercial del proyecto TDE. Se utilizan herramientas avanzadas de la oracle soa suite, tales como: Coherence, Business Rule, Decision Tree y Event Polling.

projects.title: Transformación Digital Entel Prepago
projects.description: Implementación del amplio portafolio de OSS/BSS y de Servicios de Ericsson, aportando agilidad a los negocios de Entel en Chile y Perú.
